clips.title: The story
paras: Shadowthread Cave lies beneath the northwest cliffs of Shadowglen, where its spiders have grown dangerous. Their brood now threatens young kaldorei near Aldrassil.

Shadowthread Cave opens in Shadowglen’s shaded northwest, a lair for Teldrassil’s giant spiders. In earlier years, the spiders lived quietly alongside the World Tree’s young boughs. Now they guard their territory fiercely. Webwood silk chokes the stone corridors, and the brood threatens young kaldorei venturing beyond Aldrassil.

Githyiss the Vile rules the deepest recesses of Shadowthread Cave. The monstrous broodmother is far more ferocious than the common webwood crawlers. Young night elf sentinels and druids go into the cave to curb the infestation and slay Githyiss, keeping the corruption touching Teldrassil’s wildlife from overrunning Shadowglen’s sanctuary.
